signal: Prove launched its Identity Platform in April 2026 as the trust layer for an agentic world, expanding its agentic solution suite.

email.body1:
Zach, saw Prove launched its Identity Platform as the trust layer for an agentic world, with a new agentic solution suite alongside it.

A platform expansion like that usually opens more enterprise accounts than the SE and sales bench can cover before they go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Prove off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: meetings to cover the new TAM
email.body2:
Zach, quick follow-up for Prove.

A bigger platform story means more enterprise and global accounts in play, but most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to cover that expanded TAM. The gap tends to surface late, when it is a scramble to recover the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Prove needs to cover the agentic launch this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Zach, last bit of proof for Prove.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Prove's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise security vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Zach, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem. Right after a platform launch the calendar is its own kind of full, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise identity motion? I'll tailor it to Prove either way.
